title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — April 2016–2025, Newlands, Cape Town (33.9785 S, 18.4481 E)
claims: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive for the grid cell at 33.9785 S, 18.4481 E, elevation 70 m, over the 300 April days from 2016 to 2025: mean daily maximum 21.6 °C and mean daily minimum 13.7 °C.
The same query gives mean precipitation of 1.3 mm per day; 50 of the 300 April days (16.7%) had at least 1 mm.
These are reanalysis statistics for the Newlands grid cell, not official race data and not measurements from the Chapman's Peak or Constantia sections.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直接查询 Open-Meteo archive API；坐标与海拔取自 Open-Meteo geocoding 的 Newlands, City of Cape Town（-33.97846, 18.4481, 70 m）；取 2016–2025 年 4 月共 300 天，按 daily time 过滤 04 月后计算均值。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 300 个 4 月日值；temperature_2m_max 均值 21.6，temperature_2m_min 均值 13.7。
precipitation_sum 均值 1.3 mm/day；≥1 mm 的日数 50/300 = 16.7%。
Newlands 70 m；赛道翻越 Chapman's Peak 与 Constantia Nek，本页明确不把镇区数据外推到山口。
